note: The authored site of the inhabited-room study. Every number here is a provisional choice made for this study, to be argued with: none is surveyed, engineered or a horticultural requirement. Metres, Z up, Y north, the same frame as the building. build_scene.py reads this file; change a value and run it again.

baseline.why: It is the snapshot drawings-in-code/snapshot.json selects, so the grown plantings, the plates and the deck already stand on it. v2 only recuts 18 laps; open-pier is a study, to be applied to this scene next.

setting.note: Illustrative: a level clearing in a temperate garden, northern hemisphere. There is no surveyed site.
setting.sun_note: The sky is a photograph (assets.json), mirrored and turned so that its sun stands in the west-south-west and its open side lies behind the room: a late afternoon, with the sun over the left shoulder of someone arriving. Its height, 27 degrees, is the photograph's; no date or latitude is modelled.

levels.note: Datum 0.0 is the underside of the timber feet, as in the snapshot. The soil level is not chosen here: it is feet_above_soil_m from bower/ground.py.
levels.floor_buildup_note: Built up on the stripped ground, not dug into it: bound gravel on a free-draining base, held by a steel edge.

room.note: Two bays are walked through, on one line from south to north. The other four are planted across: open to look through, not to walk through. The floor stops 0.9 m short of the pier ring, so every pier stands in a bed.

beds.note: Two crescents, east and west, each round three piers. Their soil is the garden's own, loosened and improved in place, not a container: soil_depth_m only matches the root zones' depth in bower/ground.py.

care.note: A woodchip path round the back of each bed, leaving the approach on the ramp, short of the entrance, with one stepping pad in to a standing pad outside each pier.

water.note: A standpipe where the care path leaves the approach feeds a drip line round the back of the beds, with a ring at each root zone, for the establishment years. The floor sheds to the beds; beyond the level ground the garden falls north-east to a damp hollow.

planting_at_installation.note: One climber at each root zone, drawn as a tied cane with a few leaves: a diagram of a plant put in at 2 to 3 m, not a grown or simulated one.

garden.note: Trees stand to the north, behind the room as you arrive; the south and west are left open to the sun. A border of large shrubs to the north-west gives the care path a back without shading the beds in the afternoon. Each tree is x, y, scale, turn; the border's angles run anticlockwise from east.

people.does: talking in the middle of the room
tying in a shoot at the west pier, from the standing pad

arrival.note: The eye of someone arriving on the approach path.

section.note: A vertical cut 10 mm inside the southern feet of piers R1.P6 and R1.P3, through the southern root zone and pile of each.
